name: Ludwig Feuerbach
shortBio: Young Hegelian philosopher and materialist whose critique of religion as human self-alienation directly catalyzed Marx's historical materialism and secular humanism.
centralQuestion: Is theology anything more than humanity's alienated projection of its own species-essence into an imaginary heaven?

keyWorks.title: The Essence of Christianity (Das Wesen des Christentums)
keyWorks.description: Landmark critique demonstrating that the divine is a projection of alienated human consciousness.

keyWorks.title: Principles of the Philosophy of the Future
keyWorks.description: Radical materialist manifesto advocating sensory embodiment, dialogical I-Thou relation, and naturalism.
